items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: He had a been a bandmaster for Ferdon--Ferdon Medical.

ctx.x: He played tr...he played clarinet. He had a been a bandmaster for Ferdon--Ferdon Medical. You know they used to have medicine shows and they'd have a band, and he was with him for years. And then he...we opened the music store but after a couple of years or so, he got...he wanted to go back to Ferdon, so we bought him out, and he went back and stayed two...three years, then he retired.
I see. I read several times in several places that your store evolved into kind of a hiring hall or almost booking agency...
